articles.title: How Donald Trump's proposed fresh tariff salvo for India compare with rival nations
articles.summary: The US has proposed a 25% tariff on Indian imports to address excess industrial capacity issues. This rate could decrease to 17% if a trade deal is reached. articles.title: India's wheat area set for steepest decline in 26 years as farmers switch crops
articles.summary: India is experiencing its most severe decline in wheat acreage in 26 years due to insufficient monsoon rains. articles.title: RBI flags rising inflation, says economist on firm footing
articles.summary: In October, India’s economy showcased impressive resilience, bolstered by heightened consumption and credit activities. However, retail inflation climbed to 6.1%, eclipsing the RBI's target as multiple sectors faced price hikes. Amidst this, GST collections soared to near-record heights, while unemployment dipped to 4.9% due to robust demand for goods and services.
